typicalChallenges: Are cost optimisation measures (shared tenancy, reduced redundancy) compromising security controls?
Does the cost model account for security tooling, monitoring, and incident response capabilities?
Are cheaper alternatives being considered that would not meet security classification requirements?
How are security costs justified in terms of risk reduction and compliance obligations?
Does the cost model account for operational staffing, on-call, and incident management?
Are cost savings from automation being reinvested in operational capability?
How will you balance cost optimisation with operational resilience (e.g., reducing redundancy to save money)?
What is the operational cost of managing cost optimisation itself (tagging, reporting, reviews)?
Does the budget allow for sufficient development and testing environments?
Are cost constraints limiting technology choices that would improve delivery speed?
How are cloud costs allocated between development activities and production running costs?
What is the cost of technical debt and is it factored into the total cost model?
What is the total cost of ownership over 3-5 years including all direct and indirect costs?
How predictable are the costs and what is the variance between forecast and actual?
What cost governance is in place to prevent budget overruns?
How does this compare to alternative approaches (build vs buy, cloud vs on-premises)?
